name: Republic of Mahabad (1946)
description: A horizontal tricolour of red, white and green, charged at the centre with the republic's emblem of a golden sun rising between ears of wheat.
history: The flag of the Kurdish Republic of Mahabad, proclaimed under Qazi Muhammad in Soviet-occupied north-western Iran on 22 January 1946 and crushed by the Iranian army on 15 December 1946. The reversed Iranian tricolour derived from the Komala party's 1944 flag; the design of the emblem is credited to Fatima Assad Shahin.

features.symbolism: the colours of Iran's flag reversed, as first used by the Komala party in 1944
